title: DECISION: CRDT reconcile commutativity verified by property-based tests
description: crdt_properties.rs runs 1000-case proptest on the reconcile() function verifying: want(A->B) is a subset of have(B->A), and convergence_after_partition verifies two partitioned nodes converge to identical tip sets within bounded rounds. These are correctness properties of the CRDT specification, not just implementation sanity checks. A future contributor might remove the property tests as slow or replace them with a few fixed unit tests, losing coverage of the adversarial input space.
